messages.subject: Is it possible to integrate Python with my App?
parts:
I really like R Shiny and that's why I have not turned to Python. However, most of my research community utilizes Python to develop functions and packages that would be useful in my Apps. Therefore, I was hoping to use rPython to integrate Python routines within my Shiny apps. 

Is it possible to use rPython and Python routines in Shiny Apps in either free or upgraded  plans? 

thanks,
Geoff
